title: The Pace of AI Progress
tagline: What has changed? Estimate the evidence, inspect its limits, and test a forecast.
hub_blurb: Estimate published AI measurements, inspect how the tests were run, and explore where results transfer to work.
card_blurb: Five historical measurements, a source-backed release timeline, and contrasting workplace evidence. Draw an estimate, reveal the results, then see why several forecasts can fit the same past.
description: The Pace of AI Progress teaches careful reading of AI evidence through five historical measurement activities, a selected source-backed release timeline, and bounded work/science cases. Side Details provides examples, source-linked tables, and limitations. A separate invented scenario shows linear, proportional, and saturation rules that fit the same two points. Benchmarks, protocols, human task duration, prices, and forecasts keep distinct meanings. Runs offline with Guide, Settings, presentation mode, Reset, canonical presenter notes and a four-page printable PDF.
